description: Search dedicated, VPS, GPU and cloud server plans by specification, location, price and provider capability. Returns plans with on-site ServerSearcher URLs and affiliate checkout URLs.

cloudServices.description: Restrict to providers offering any of these managed services, e.g. ["OBJECT_STORAGE","MANAGED_KUBERNETES"]

cpuModel.description: Substring of the CPU model, e.g. "EPYC". `*` and `?` are glob wildcards: "EPYC*9004" matches "AMD EPYC 9004".

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency codes to restrict prices to, e.g. ["USD","EUR"]

diskTypes.description: Disk types, e.g. NVMe, SSD, HDD

gpuModel.description: Exact GPU model name, e.g. "NVIDIA H100"

hasTerraform.description: Only providers with an official or community Terraform provider

location.description: Locations: an ISO country code ("DE"), a country and city ("DE-frankfurt"), or a city id

maxPrice.description: Maximum listed monthly price, in the listed currency

minBandwidth.description: Minimum included bandwidth in TB per month

minCpuFrequency.description: Minimum CPU base frequency in GHz

minDiskCapacity.description: Minimum capacity of a single disk, in GB

minPortSpeed.description: Minimum network port speed in Mbps; matches either port

provider.description: Provider slugs (e.g. "runpod") or internal provider ids — slugs are what URLs and get_provider_info use and are resolved for you.

sortConfig.description: Sort order. The pricePer* keys rank by USD price per unit of RAM or CPU.

type.description: Plan types to include. Omit for all types.

unmetered.description: Only plans with unmetered bandwidth (no monthly transfer quota)

name: search_servers
